behaviour: Any neutral-tasting liquid cooking fat, used to fry and to coat a pan. It carries heat well and takes on the taste of what is cooked in it, and it smokes and turns acrid if it is heated past its limit.

contains.basis: Oil sold only as vegetable oil is often pressed from soybeans.
Oil sold only as vegetable oil may be pressed from peanuts.

safety.note: A named oil such as olive or sunflower oil has a file of its own. This one stands for any oil a recipe does not name.

stands_in_for.caveat: It lacks the nutty, buttery taste.
It is neutral too, though the taste can vary with the kind.
